entry.title: Exercise 2 published
entry.content:
The 2nd exercise has been published and can be downloaded via the exercises-page or if you have an KIT affiliation, you can access it via Jupyter Hub.

To view it, you need a local Jupyter notebook installation with Python >= 3.8.
